title: Global well-posedness of the Boltzmann equation via bilinear estimates
summary: We prove global well-posedness of the hard-sphere Boltzmann equation in $\mathbb{R}^d$ for small initial data in the critical Besov space $B_{1,1}^{d-1}L_v^1$ and in the critical Sobolev space $W^{d-1,1}L_v^1$. The proof is based on new bilinear estimates for the nonlinear collision operator, which rely on transversality considerations.
